#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader(std::istream& stream) : stream(stream), buffer(1024), index(0), length(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int result = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpace(c));
        return result * sign;
    }

private:
    std::istream& stream;
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    int index;
    int length;

    int read() {
        if (length == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (index >= length) {
            index = 0;
            try {
                length = stream.readsome(&buffer[0], buffer.size());
            } catch (...) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            }
            if (length <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[index++]);
    }

    static bool isSpace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class ProblemSolver {
public:
    void solve(int testNum, FastReader& reader, std::ostream& writer) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = reader.nextInt();
        int k = reader.nextInt();
        std::vector<int> values(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx = reader.nextInt();
            values[idx] = 1;
        }

        std::vector<int> result = {1};
        int exponent = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = convolve(result, values, MOD);
            }
            exponent >>= 1;
            if (exponent == 0) break;
            values = convolve(values, values, MOD);
        }

        int answer = 0;
        for (int val : result) {
            answer = (int)((answer + static_cast<long long>(val) * val) % MOD);
        }
        writer << answer << std::endl;
    }

private:
    static std::vector<double> cosine;
    static std::vector<double> sine;
    static std::vector<double> cosineInv;
    static std::vector<double> sineInv;

    static void initializeTables() {
        static bool initialized = false;
        if (!initialized) {
            cosine.resize(1 << 20);
            sine.resize(1 << 20);
            cosineInv.resize(1 << 20);
            sineInv.resize(1 << 20);
            
            for (int segment = 1; segment <= cosine.size(); segment <<= 1) {
                int offset = segment >> 1;
                for (int i = offset; i < segment; i++) {
                    double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - offset) / segment;
                    cosine[i] = cos(angle);
                    sine[i] = sin(angle);
                    cosineInv[i] = cos(-angle);
                    sineInv[i] = sin(-angle);
                }
            }
            initialized = true;
        }
    }

    static std::vector<int> convolve(const std::vector<int>& arrA, const std::vector<int>& arrB, int mod) {
        int targetSize = arrA.size() + arrB.size() - 1;
        int size = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(targetSize - 1)));

        std::vector<double> aReal(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> aImag(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < arrA.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((arrA[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            aImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(aReal, aImag, false);

        std::vector<double> bReal(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> bImag(size, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < arrB.size(); i++) {
            int x = ((arrB[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        performFFT(bReal, bImag, false);

        std::vector<double> prodReal(size, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> prodImag(size, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            prodReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            prodImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        }

        performFFT(prodReal, prodImag, true);

        std::vector<int> output(targetSize, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < targetSize; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(prodReal[i]);
            long long bb = llround(prodImag[i]);
            long long cc = llround(prodImag[size - i]);
            output[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return output;
    }

    static void performFFT(std::vector<double>& reals, std::vector<double>& imags, bool isInverse) {
        initializeTables();
        int n = reals.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_bswap32(i << bits) >> bits;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(reals[i], reals[j]);
                std::swap(imags[i], imags[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            int step = cosine.size() / len;

            for (int group = 0; group < n; group += len) {
                for (int idx = 0, wIdx = 0; idx < half; idx++, wIdx += step) {
                    double wRe = isInverse ? cosineInv[half + idx] : cosine[half + idx];
                    double wIm = isInverse ? sineInv[half + idx] : sine[half + idx];

                    int idx1 = group + idx;
                    int idx2 = group + idx + half;

                    double uRe = reals[idx1];
                    double uIm = imags[idx1];
                    double vRe = reals[idx2] * wRe - imags[idx2] * wIm;
                    double vIm = reals[idx2] * wIm + imags[idx2] * wRe;

                    reals[idx1] = uRe + vRe;
                    imags[idx1] = uIm + vIm;
                    reals[idx2] = uRe - vRe;
                    imags[idx2] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (isInverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                reals[i] /= n;
                imags[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

std::vector<double> ProblemSolver::cosine;
std::vector<double> ProblemSolver::sine;
std::vector<double> ProblemSolver::cosineInv;
std::vector<double> ProblemSolver::sineInv;

int main() {
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);

    ProblemSolver solver;
    solver.solve(1, FastReader(std::cin), std::cout);

    return 0;
}
